ja250:1.1: This seer, delighting in calm and restraint
ja250:1.2: Stands afflicted by the fear of winter,
ja250:1.3: Come now, please enter into this household,
ja250:1.4: Drive away all cold and anxiety.
ja250:2.1: This is no seer, delighting in calm and restraint,
ja250:2.2: This is a monkey who ranges in tree branches.
ja250:2.3: He is a spoiler, a provocateur, vulgar,
ja250:2.4: If he comes inside he will surely spoil my home.
